Based on the screenshot of the YouTube Playlists page (`/feed/playlists`), here is the detailed description:

### 1. Grid Cards (Titles, Counts, and Links)

### 2. Thumbnail Treatment
All visible thumbnails use the **single image treatment** (a solid color placeholder in this wireframe/screenshot). They do not use the "stacked images" (collage) style typically seen on channel pages; instead, they feature a single rectangular block with the video/lesson count overlaid in a dark pill-shaped badge in the bottom-right corner.

### 3. Card Geometry
*   **Thumbnail Aspect Ratio:** The thumbnails are in a **16:9 landscape aspect ratio**.
*   **Title Placement:** The title is placed **below the thumbnail**, left-aligned. It uses a bold, larger font.
*   **Layout:** Below the title, there are two lines of smaller grey text: the first line contains the visibility/status (e.g., Private/Public) and the type (Playlist/Course); the second line contains the 'View full...' link.

### 4. Controls ('New Playlist' Button & Sort)
*   **'New Playlist' Button:** There is **no visible 'New playlist' button** in the main content area or header shown in the screenshot.
*   **Sort/Filter Controls:** Below the main 'Playlists' heading, there is a horizontal row of **filter chips/tabs** used for sorting or categorizing:
    *   'Recently added' (currently selected/active)
    *   'Playlists'
    *   'Music'
    *   'Courses'
    *   'Owned'
    *   'Saved'
